label: pass
title: Support filtering GET /books by author and tag
body:
Clients need to filter the catalogue:

- `GET /books?author=martin` → books whose author contains the text (case-insensitive)
- `GET /books?tag=craft` → books that have exactly that tag
- both filters can be combined; with no filters the full list is returned as today.

Please add tests.
plan:
Extend GET /books to support optional query parameters ?author=... (case-insensitive substring match) and ?tag=... (exact tag match), allowing both to be combined. Add server API tests to cover author-only, tag-only, combined filtering, and no-filter behavior.
1. Update GET /books handler to apply query-based filtering
2. Add tests for GET /books filtering by author, tag, combined filters, and unfiltered list
requirements: GET /books?author=martin returns books whose author contains the provided text (case-insensitive substring match).
GET /books?tag=craft returns books that have exactly that tag.
If both author and tag are provided, both filters are applied (intersection).
If no filters are provided, GET /books returns the full list as today.
Add tests validating the above behaviors for the GET /books endpoint.
summary:
Implemented GET /books filtering by optional query params: author uses case-insensitive substring match; tag matches exactly against book.tags; both can be combined. Added server tests covering unfiltered list, author-only, tag-only, and combined filtering.

Requirements:
1. src/server.js GET /books supports ?author (case-insensitive substring)
2. src/server.js GET /books supports ?tag exact tag match
3. src/server.js GET /books applies both filters together when provided
4. test/server.test.js verifies unfiltered GET /books returns full catalogue
5. test/server.test.js verifies GET /books filtering behaviors (author, tag, combined)

@@ -11,9 +11,22 @@ import { formatCurrency } from './format.js'
 export function createApp(inventory = Inventory.fromFile()) {
   const router = new Router()
 
-  router.get('/health', () => ({ status: 200, body: { status: 'ok' } }))
+	router.get('/health', () => ({ status: 200, body: { status: 'ok' } }))
 
-  router.get('/books', () => ({ status: 200, body: inventory.list() }))
+	router.get('/books', ({ query }) => {
+	  const author = query.get('author')
+	  const tag = query.get('tag')
+	
+	  let books = inventory.list()
+	  if (author) {
+	    const q = String(author).toLowerCase()
+	    books = books.filter((b) => b.author.toLowerCase().includes(q))
+	  }
+	  if (tag) {
+	    books = books.filter((b) => Array.isArray(b.tags) && b.tags.includes(tag))
+	  }
+	  return { status: 200, body: books }
+	})
